what it is: past the end of a member's packed data the input reads as zero bits; a main symbol whose first bit is fewer than 8 bits past the end is decoded, and at the first one that would begin 8 or more bits past it the member stops
a match that passes the member's declared end is cut there, and its rest is produced at the start of the next member of the chain
a table read that fails after the declared size leaves the stream inside the block it was in
packed data left when the declared size has been produced is not read
a member declaring 0 bytes at a header expected point has its packed data passed over
